# Content Machine
> Turns one long video into a consistent, scheduled stream of short vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, driven by Claude.

## Start here
- [Setup playbook](playbook/setup.md): what Claude does when a user says "set up Content Machine" on a fresh clone
- [Run playbook](playbook/run.md): what Claude does when a user says "Using Content Machine: <link>"
- [README](README.md): overview, screenshots, quick start
- [index.html](index.html): the live dashboard for every project; keep it open
